thread.title: Apple and Goldman Sachs in joint credit card venture

author: Tripp Mickle and Liz Hoffman
title: Apple and Goldman Sachs in joint credit card venture
text:
Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.25% and Goldman Sachs Group Inc. GS, +1.18% are preparing to launch a new joint credit card, a move that would deepen the technology giant’s push into its customers’ wallets and mark the Wall Street firm’s first foray into plastic.
The planned card would carry the Apple Pay brand and could launch early next year, people familiar with the matter said. Apple will replace its longstanding rewards-card partnership with BCS, +0.39% PLC, the people said.
The Apple-Goldman card could help the companies combat weaknesses in their core businesses. As new iPhone sales growth slows, Apple is focusing on services such as mobile payments, streaming-music subscriptions, and App Store sales. Apple Pay, which generates revenue on each transaction, is a key contributor, but adoption has been slower than executives hoped.
